units.source_text: 无论是这时还是正月里下连棋的时候，他也是热心棋艺，

en.t: Whether at this time or when he played consecutive games during the New Year, he too was devoted to the art of go,

units.source_text: 每一手都一丝不苟，与其说他是重视名人的责任，不如说这是自发的行为。

en.t: and he treated every move with meticulous care; rather than saying he was mindful of the Master's responsibility, it was more a spontaneous act on his part.
